tasks.label: validate-manifests
tasks.command: echo 'Validating Kubernetes manifests...' && find manifests/ -name '*.yaml' -exec kubectl validate --dry-run=client -f {} \;

tasks.label: git-push-sync
tasks.command: git add . && git commit -m 'GitOps update' && git push && echo '✅ Changes pushed - ArgoCD will sync in 30-60 seconds'
